newsitem.title: USA: DynaGen Inc files patent on imaging.
newsitem.headline: DynaGen Inc files patent on imaging.

text.p: DynaGen Inc said Monday that it has filed a U.S. patent application detailing the methods and apparatus for sensing and imaging anatomy and surgical instruments during a surgical procedure.
The company said the patent covered many applications, but its use in improving the accuracy and efficiency of breast surgical biopsy procedures was highlighted in its application.

DynaGen said the apparatus, termed the BioLocator Sytem, consists of components that produce representations of the breast and of the lesion, track the position of the surgical instrument, and coordinate viewing of the breast, lesion, and the surgeon's instruments on one image screen.
